annotations.title: Create a Cloud, Data, Studio, or Mobile project

description: Creates one Cloud site, Data project, Studio browser app, or Mobile Expo starter on this account. The only action is create, for product cloud, data, studio, or mobile. Use create_project when that project does not exist yet. Use list_projects to find an existing id, project to read or replace Studio source or a Mobile draft, and deploy to publish Cloud HTML. product code is an error: Code has no server-side project. Nothing is deployed or charged.

name.description: Display name. Cloud and Data: 1 to 64 characters. Studio: 1 to 100. Mobile: 1 to 80. Control characters are rejected.

product.description: Product to create. cloud, data, studio, or mobile. code is accepted and refused: Code has no server-side project.

slug.description: Required for Cloud only. Public address, 1 to 48 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and internal hyphens. Reserved names are rejected. A taken slug is an error, not an overwrite.

name: create_project
title: Create a Cloud, Data, Studio, or Mobile project
